ent_formalism_transformer_action_decoder.name: Transformer Action Decoder Formalism
ent_formalism_transformer_action_decoder.summary: A formal generative framework that decodes robot actions from visual-language context using a Transformer architecture and a learned action token vocabulary.
ent_formalism_transformer_action_decoder.body:
## Overview

The Transformer Action Decoder Formalism is a formal generative framework that uses a Transformer architecture and a learned action token vocabulary to decode robot actions from visual-linguistic context. It discretizes the continuous action space into token sequences and generates actions token-by-token in an autoregressive manner, thereby reusing the training and inference ecosystem of language models. What it truly changes is not the precision of action prediction itself, but rather enabling robot action generation to share the same formal interface as large-scale pretrained language models.

ent_formalism_inverse_dynamics_qp.name: Inverse-Dynamics QP Formulation
ent_formalism_inverse_dynamics_qp.summary: A quadratic-program formulation that computes generalized accelerations, contact forces, and joint torques by minimizing task-tracking errors subject to floating-base dynamics and physical constraints.
ent_formalism_inverse_dynamics_qp.body:
## Overview

The Inverse-Dynamics QP Formulation is the mainstream standard formulation for torque-level whole-body control (WBC). It takes the joint accelerations, joint torques, and contact forces as decision variables, and solves for the optimal control inputs that satisfy dynamic consistency and contact stability in one shot by minimizing task tracking errors subject to floating-base dynamics and physical constraints. What it truly changes is not the accuracy of solving a single inverse dynamics problem, but the unification of "dynamic feasibility" and "task optimality" into the same convex optimization framework, moving high-dimensional, underactuated, and strongly coupled humanoid robot control from heuristic tuning to provable real-time optimization.
